build_isolation: Separate Cargo target directories for baseline, optimized native, and optimized scalar builds.
baseline_harness_adaptation: Same phase-separated benchmark, with the base phase using the old API: base_output.par_chunks_mut(pcs.base.n0()).zip(message.par_chunks(pcs.base.k0())).for_each(|(output,input)| pcs.base.encode_slice(input,output)).
aggregation: Median per phase and configuration; speedup = median baseline / median optimized.

timing_scope.base: All base codewords; output buffer allocation is excluded. Baseline uses one message per parallel iterator item; optimized Lagrange encoding uses four, while FFT retains one.
timing_scope.encode: Complete encode_top, including allocation and final layout change; destruction of returned output is excluded.
timing_scope.commit: Public HyperFoldPcs::commit, including encoding, Merkle tree and evaluation; witness cloning and destruction of returned data are excluded.

setup: One setup and one fixed message per configuration, outside all timers; each phase is measured separately.
simd: Goldilocks packing width 8 with native flags. H4/H8 use packing; H2 retains scalar evaluation. M127 and extension-valued Field::Packing width 1 use scalar evaluation.
correctness: All before/after commitment roots match, including across thread counts for matching configurations. Frozen proof bytes and independent Newton/matrix checks pass.
notes: Local measurements at mu=20; speedups are not guarantees for other CPUs or message sizes.
Single-thread measurements cover r=2,4,8 for Goldilocks and r=2,8 for M127. 32-thread measurements cover r=2,4,8 for both fields.
A Goldilocks r=4,c=2 outlier in the initial 32-thread sweep was allocator-sensitive. All saved 32-thread samples were replaced with fresh-process measurements for every configuration.
Goldilocks r=2 has no measured benefit and shows about 2-3% slower complete encoding despite retaining scalar H2. Gains depend on configuration; the full signed results are retained in summary.csv.

process_isolation.32: Each (field,r,c) configuration runs in its own fresh process; baseline and optimized are run consecutively per configuration.
process_isolation.1: r=2,8 run in one process per version, with Goldilocks followed by M127; Goldilocks r=4 runs separately per version.
